profile_type.description:
The type of the Revolut profile.
Indicates whether the counterparty is a personal or business account.
Provide it when adding a Revolut counterparty via Revtag.

revtag.description: The [Revtag](https://help.revolut.com/help/transfers/internal-transfers/username-payments/revtags/) of the counterparty to add.

name.description:
The name of the counterparty, provided when the counterparty is being added via **Revtag**.

If specified, `individual_name` and `company_name` must be empty.

:::note
The name that you provide must match or closely match the actual name associated with the account that you're trying to add.
Otherwise, the creation fails and a `404` error is returned.
:::

company_name.description:
The name of the counterparty, provided when the counterparty is a **company** (business account type) and is **not** being added via Revtag.

If specified, `individual_name` and `name` must be empty.

:::warning
The `company_name` must contain at least 2 letters (not just characters).
For example, names like `12` will fail validation because they are two characters but not two letters.
:::

account_no.description: The bank account number of the counterparty.

iban.description: The IBAN number of the counterparty's account. This field is displayed for IBAN countries.

sort_code.description: The sort code of the counterparty's account. This field is required for GBP accounts.

routing_number.description: The routing number of the counterparty's account. This field is required for USD accounts.

bic.description: The BIC number of the counterparty's account. This field is required for non-SEPA IBAN/SWIFT.

clabe.description: The CLABE number of the counterparty's account. This field is required for SWIFT MX.

ifsc.description: The IFSC number of the counterparty's account. This field is required for INR accounts.

bsb_code.description: The BSB number of the counterparty's account. This field is required for AUD accounts.

route.description:
Routing method for US USD transfers. When omitted, defaults to `ach` for US-registered businesses and `fedwire` for non-US businesses. 

Required when `bank_country` is `US` and the desired routing method differs from the default.

bank_number.description: Brazilian bank identification code (COMPE). Required for BR counterparties.

branch_code.description: Brazilian branch (agência) code. Required for BR counterparties.

account_type.description:
Bank account type. Defaults to `checking` for US ACH transfers when omitted. 

Required for BR, CO, and CL counterparties.

tax_id.description:
Tax identification number.

Required and routed based on `bank_country` and recipient type:
- **BR**:
  - **Individual**: CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas). Accepted formats: `^\d{11}$` or `^\d{3}\.\d{3}\.\d{3}-\d{2}$`.
  - **Company**: CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica). Accepted formats: `^\d{14}$` or `^\d{2}\.\d{3}\.\d{3}/\d{4}-\d{2}$`.
- **CO (company)**: NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). Accepted format: `^\d{10}$`.
- **CL (individual, company)**: RUT (Rol Único Tributario).

national_id.description: National identification number. Required  when `bank_country` is `CO` and `profile_type` is `personal`, must specify Colombian Cédula de Ciudadanía.

phone.description:
The phone number of the counterparty in [E.164](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E.164) format.

- For internal (Revolut) counterparties: the recipient's Revolut phone number used to look them up.
- For external counterparties in CO, KR, and LK: the bank account phone number. Required when `bank_country` is `CO`, `KR`, or `LK`.

Country-specific formats:
- **CO**: `+57` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?57\d{10}$`)
- **KR**: `+82` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?82\d{10}$`)
- **LK**: `+94` followed by 10 digits (`^\+?94\d{10}$`)

business_registration_id.description: Company registration number. Required for business LK counterparties (`profile_type`: `business`).

BankCountryCode.description: The country of the bank, provided as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

region.description: The name of the region (state or province), for example, Ontario for Canada.

country.description: The country of the counterparty, as a 2-letter [ISO 3166](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_ISO_3166_country_codes) code.

postcode.description: The postcode of the counterparty address.

IndividualName.description:
The name of the counterparty, provided when the counterparty is an **individual** (personal account type) and is **not** being added via Revtag.

If specified, `company_name` and `name` must be empty.

first_name.description: The first name of the individual counterparty.

last_name.description: The last name of the individual counterparty.
